caption: The drawing depicts two oval-shaped wooden boxes with a light yellow-brown coloration, featuring fine lines and small dots suggesting wood grain and fasteners. The upper box is closed and shown slightly elevated, while the lower box is open with the lid resting against its rim, revealing a darker brown interior. Both boxes have overlapping joints on their sides, secured with evenly spaced small dots that resemble nails or tacks, and display a smooth texture without visible handles or additional decorations. The composition places the closed box near the upper center and the open box below and slightly to the left, against a plain, light background.
title: Shaker Box
